H669: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H6921: the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1285: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H804: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H4714: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
H2986: properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H6485: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H990: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
H6117: to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H251: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H7786: properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H3201: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H3667: Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3976: (only in the dual) a pair of scales
H6231: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H6238: properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich
H3018: toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H4150: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
H2377: a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle
H1819: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H1568: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
H205: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H7723: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1537: Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine
H2076: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H1530: something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves)
H1272: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H758: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H3707: to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H5203: properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.)
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
